chunks.title: Cotton Sugarcane Pest Management
chunks.source: ICAR-Central Institute for Cotton Research (CICR) & Sugarcane Breeding Institute (SBI)
chunks.text:
ICAR COTTON & SUGARCANE PEST & DISEASE MANAGEMENT MANUAL
Document Source: ICAR-Central Institute for Cotton Research (CICR) & Sugarcane Breeding Institute (SBI)
Official Portals: https://cicr.org.in | https://sugarcane.icar.gov.in

chunks.title: Cotton Sugarcane Pest Management
chunks.source: ICAR-Central Institute for Cotton Research (CICR) & Sugarcane Breeding Institute (SBI)
chunks.text:
1. COTTON PINK BOLLWORM (GULABI SUNDI) MANAGEMENT
Pink bollworm (Pectinophora gossypiella) damages developing bolls, leading to poor lint quality and premature boll dropping.
Integrated Pest Management (IPM):
- Install Pheromone Traps @ 5 to 8 traps per acre for pest monitoring.
- Spray Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 4 grams per 10 litres of water (80g/acre) or Profenofos 50% EC @ 2 ml per litre of water.
- Avoid late spraying of synthetic pyrethroids which induce secondary pest outbreaks.

chunks.title: Cotton Sugarcane Pest Management
chunks.source: ICAR-Central Institute for Cotton Research (CICR) & Sugarcane Breeding Institute (SBI)
chunks.text:
2. SUGARCANE RED ROT (LAAL SADAN) DISEASE
Colletotrichum falcatum causes Red Rot in sugarcane. Internal tissues of stalks turn red with white cross-bands and alcohol-like fermented odor.
Remedial Protocol:
- Uproot and burn infected clumps immediately.
- Treat seed setts before planting in Carbendazim 50% WP @ 2 grams per litre of water for 30 minutes.
- Spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 150 ml per hectare for Top Borer control.

chunks.title: ICAR Rice Paddy Protection Manual
chunks.source: ICAR-National Rice Research Institute (NRRI), Cuttack
chunks.text:
ICAR RICE & PADDY CROP PROTECTION MANUAL
Document Source: ICAR-National Rice Research Institute (NRRI), Cuttack
Official Portal: https://icar-crri.res.in

chunks.title: ICAR Rice Paddy Protection Manual
chunks.source: ICAR-National Rice Research Institute (NRRI), Cuttack
chunks.text:
1. RICE BLAST DISEASE (MAGNAPORTHE ORYZAE)
Rice Blast is one of the most destructive diseases in paddy cultivation affecting leaves, nodes, and neck of panicles.
Symptoms: Spindle-shaped/eye-shaped brown lesions with grey/white centres on leaves. Neck blast turns panicles dark and causes grain filling failure.
Chemical Treatment: Spray Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 0.6 grams per litre of water (120g/acre) or Isoprothiolane 40% EC @ 1.5 ml/litre of water.

chunks.title: ICAR Rice Paddy Protection Manual
chunks.source: ICAR-National Rice Research Institute (NRRI), Cuttack
chunks.text: Cultural Management: Avoid excessive Nitrogen application. Keep water level at 2-3 cm during peak tillering stage. Use resistant varieties like Pusa Basmati 1121, PR 126, or Swarna Sub-1.

chunks.title: ICAR Rice Paddy Protection Manual
chunks.source: ICAR-National Rice Research Institute (NRRI), Cuttack
chunks.text:
2. SHEATH BLIGHT (RHIZOCTONIA SOLANI)
Symptoms: Oval or irregular greenish-grey water-soaked spots on leaf sheaths near water line.
Remedy: Spray Hexaconazole 5% EC @ 2 ml/litre or Validamycin 3% L @ 2 ml/litre.

3. BROWN PLANT HOPPER (BPH) PEST CONTROL
Symptoms: Circular patches of dried/browned plants in the field known as 'hopper burn'.
Remedy: Spray Pymetrozine 50% WDG @ 120g/acre or Dinotefuran 20% SG @ 80g/acre. Alternate irrigation to dry field periodically.

chunks.title: ICAR Wheat Crop Management Advisory
chunks.source: ICAR-Indian Institute of Wheat and Barley Research (IIWBR), Karnal
chunks.text:
ICAR WHEAT CROP MANAGEMENT & DISEASE ADVISORY MANUAL
Document Source: ICAR-Indian Institute of Wheat and Barley Research (IIWBR), Karnal
Official Portal: https://icar.org.in

chunks.title: ICAR Wheat Crop Management Advisory
chunks.source: ICAR-Indian Institute of Wheat and Barley Research (IIWBR), Karnal
chunks.text:
1. YELLOW RUST (PILA RATUWA) DIAGNOSIS & REMEDIATION
Yellow rust (Puccinia striiformis) is a serious fungal disease affecting wheat in Northern Plains.
Symptoms: Bright yellow pustules appear in linear rows along the veins on leaf blades. Upon touching, yellow powder sticks to fingers.

chunks.title: ICAR Wheat Crop Management Advisory
chunks.source: ICAR-Indian Institute of Wheat and Barley Research (IIWBR), Karnal
chunks.text:
Chemical Remedy: Spray Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1.0 ml per litre of water (200 ml per acre in 200 litres of water) or Tebuconazole 250 EC immediately upon symptom appearance. Repeat spray after 15 days if rust spreads.
Resistant Varieties: HD 2967, DBW 187 (Karan Vandana), PBW 550, HD 3086, DBW 222.

chunks.title: ICAR Wheat Crop Management Advisory
chunks.source: ICAR-Indian Institute of Wheat and Barley Research (IIWBR), Karnal
chunks.text:
2. ZINC & NITROGEN DEFICIENCY (YELLOWING OF LEAVES)
Symptoms: Pale yellowing of upper or younger leaves without pustules or powder.
Remedy: Foliar spray of 0.5% Zinc Sulphate (21% Zn) + 1.0% Urea (dissolve 1 kg Zinc Sulphate + 2 kg Urea in 200 litres of water per acre). Apply basal dose of 25 kg/hectare Zinc Sulphate during field preparation.

chunks.title: ICAR Wheat Crop Management Advisory
chunks.source: ICAR-Indian Institute of Wheat and Barley Research (IIWBR), Karnal
chunks.text:
3. FERTILIZER SCHEDULE FOR WHEAT
Recommended NPK Ratio: 120 kg Nitrogen (N), 60 kg Phosphorus (P2O5), and 40 kg Potash (K2O) per hectare.
Basal Application (At Sowing): Apply 50 kg DAP + 30 kg Urea + 20 kg MOP per acre at the time of sowing.
Top Dressing: Apply remaining Urea in two splits: 30 kg/acre at 1st irrigation (Crown Root Initiation - CRI stage, 21 days after sowing) and 30 kg/acre at 2nd irrigation (Jointing stage, 45 days after sowing).

chunks.title: ICAR Wheat Crop Management Advisory
chunks.source: ICAR-Indian Institute of Wheat and Barley Research (IIWBR), Karnal
chunks.text:
4. IRRIGATION SCHEDULE
Wheat requires 5-6 irrigations depending on soil texture. Critical stages for irrigation:
1. Crown Root Initiation (CRI) - 20-25 days after sowing (Most Critical)
2. Tillering stage - 40-45 days after sowing
3. Jointing stage - 60-65 days after sowing
4. Flowering stage - 80-85 days after sowing
5. Milk/Grain filling stage - 100-105 days after sowing

chunks.title: Kisan Credit Card KCC Scheme Rules
chunks.source: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) & RBI
chunks.text:
KISAN CREDIT CARD (KCC) SCHEME - RULES & APPLICATION GUIDELINES
Document Source: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) & RBI
Official Portal: https://nabard.org

chunks.title: Kisan Credit Card KCC Scheme Rules
chunks.source: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) & RBI
chunks.text:
1. PURPOSE & SALIENT FEATURES
The Kisan Credit Card (KCC) scheme aims at providing adequate and timely credit support from the banking system to farmers for their short-term crop production needs, post-harvest expenses, produce marketing loan, consumption requirements, and maintenance of farm assets & activities allied to agriculture (dairy, fishery, poultry).

chunks.title: Kisan Credit Card KCC Scheme Rules
chunks.source: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) & RBI
chunks.text:
2. CREDIT LIMIT & LOW INTEREST BENEFIT
- Maximum collateral-free loan limit up to Rs. 1.60 Lakh (extendable up to Rs. 3 Lakh with flexible security).
- Benchmark Interest Rate: 7% per annum.
- Prompt Repayment Incentive (PRI): Interest subvention of 3% per annum is granted to farmers who repay their loan on or before the due date, reducing the effective interest rate to ONLY 4% per annum.

chunks.title: Kisan Credit Card KCC Scheme Rules
chunks.source: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) & RBI
chunks.text:
3. ELIGIBILITY & DOCUMENTATION
Eligible Beneficiaries: Individual farmers, joint borrowers, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers, and Self Help Groups (SHGs) / Joint Liability Groups (JLGs).
Documents Required:
- Duly filled KCC Application Form
- Identity Proof (Aadhaar Card / Voter ID / PAN)
- Address Proof (Aadhaar / Ration Card)
- Landholding Proof (Khasra / Khatauni document signed by Revenue Authority)
- Passport-size photographs

chunks.title: Kisan Credit Card KCC Scheme Rules
chunks.source: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) & RBI
chunks.text: Application Locations: Any Commercial Bank, Regional Rural Bank (RRB), State Cooperative Bank, or Common Service Centre (CSC).

chunks.title: PMFBY Crop Insurance Policy Guidelines
chunks.source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Govt of India
chunks.text:
PRADHAN MANTRI FASAL BIMA YOJANA (PMFBY) - CROP INSURANCE POLICY GUIDELINES
Document Source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Govt of India
Official Portal: https://pmfby.gov.in
Toll-Free Helpline: 1800-180-1551

chunks.title: PMFBY Crop Insurance Policy Guidelines
chunks.source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Govt of India
chunks.text:
1. SCHEME OBJECTIVE & COVERAGE
Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) provides comprehensive crop insurance coverage against non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest stage (drought, dry spells, flood, inundation, pests & diseases, landslide, natural fire, lightning, storm, hailstorm, and cyclone).

chunks.title: PMFBY Crop Insurance Policy Guidelines
chunks.source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Govt of India
chunks.text:
2. PREMIUM RATES FOR FARMERS
Farmers pay a nominal uniform premium rate for all crops insured:
- Kharif Crops (Food grains & Oilseeds): Maximum 2.0% of Sum Insured
- Rabi Crops (Food grains & Oilseeds): Maximum 1.5% of Sum Insured
- Commercial & Annual Horticultural Crops: Maximum 5.0% of Sum Insured
The balance premium is subsidized equally (50:50) by the Central Government and State Government.

chunks.title: PMFBY Crop Insurance Policy Guidelines
chunks.source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Govt of India
chunks.text:
3. MANDATORY INTIMATION TIME PERIOD FOR CROP LOSS CLAIM
In case of localized calamities (hailstorm, landslide, inundation, cloudburst, natural fire) or post-harvest losses, intimation of loss must be reported within 72 HOURS of the event.
Intimation Channels:
- PMFBY Crop Insurance App (Download from Google Play Store)
- Toll-free Helpline Number: 1800-180-1551
- Nearest Bank Branch / Insurance Company Office / Agriculture Officer
- CSC (Common Service Center)

chunks.title: PMFBY Crop Insurance Policy Guidelines
chunks.source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Govt of India
chunks.text: Documents required for claim settlement: Land title passbook, Bank passbook copy, Aadhaar card, and photos of damaged crop field.

chunks.title: PM KISAN Official Scheme Guidelines
chunks.source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
chunks.text:
PRADHAN MANTRI KISAN SAMMAN NIDHI (PM-KISAN) - OFFICIAL SCHEME GUIDELINES
Document Source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
Official Portal: https://pmkisan.gov.in

chunks.title: PM KISAN Official Scheme Guidelines
chunks.source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
chunks.text:
1. SCHEME OVERVIEW & BENEFITS
Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) is a Central Sector Scheme providing income support to all landholding farmer families across the country to enable them to take care of expenses related to agriculture and allied activities as well as domestic needs. Under the scheme, financial benefit of Rs. 6,000/- per per annum is transferred directly into the bank accounts of farmer families in three equal installments of Rs. 2,000/- every four months.

chunks.title: PM KISAN Official Scheme Guidelines
chunks.source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
chunks.text:
2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA
All landholding farmers' families, which have cultivable landholding in their names are eligible to get benefit under the scheme.

chunks.title: PM KISAN Official Scheme Guidelines
chunks.source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
chunks.text: Exclusions: High net-worth individuals, institutional landholders, former and present holders of constitutional posts, former and present Ministers/ State Ministers, Mayor of Municipal Corporations, Chairperson of District Panchayats, serving or retired officers/employees of State/Central Government, all superannuated/retired pensioners whose monthly pension is Rs. 10,000/- or more, and income tax payers in the last assessment year.

chunks.title: PM KISAN Official Scheme Guidelines
chunks.source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
chunks.text:
3. HOW TO REGISTER (NEW FARMER REGISTRATION)
Farmers can apply online by visiting the official PM-KISAN portal (https://pmkisan.gov.in) and selecting 'New Farmer Registration'. Alternatively, registration can be done through the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or State Nodal Officer (Agriculture).

chunks.title: PM KISAN Official Scheme Guidelines
chunks.source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
chunks.text:
4. MANDATORY DOCUMENTS REQUIRED FOR REGISTRATION
- Aadhaar Card (Mandatory for identity verification)
- Bank Account Passbook (Bank account must be seeded with Aadhaar and NPCI mapping enabled for Direct Benefit Transfer)
- Landholding ownership document (Khasra/Khatauni copy showing land title)
- Active Mobile Number for OTP authentication and status updates

chunks.title: PM KISAN Official Scheme Guidelines
chunks.source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
chunks.text:
5. MANDATORY e-KYC & AADHAAR SEEDING
To receive future installments without interruption, all registered farmers must complete Aadhaar-based e-KYC. e-KYC can be done via OTP authentication on the PM-KISAN Portal/App or using biometric authentication at any CSC center. Bank accounts must be linked with Aadhaar to avoid payment failures.

chunks.title: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana PMKSY
chunks.source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Govt of India
chunks.text:
PRADHAN MANTRI KRISHI SINCHAYEE YOJANA (PMKSY) & MICRO-IRRIGATION GUIDELINES
Document Source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Govt of India
Official Portal: https://pmksy.gov.in

1. SCHEME OBJECTIVE: 'PER DROP MORE CROP'
PMKSY focuses on enhancing water use efficiency at farm level through Micro-Irrigation systems like Drip Irrigation (Tapkan Sinchai) and Sprinkler Irrigation (Fawwara Sinchai).

chunks.title: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana PMKSY
chunks.source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Govt of India
chunks.text:
2. ADVANTAGES OF DRIP & SPRINKLER IRRIGATION
- Drip Irrigation saves 40% to 50% water compared to conventional flood irrigation.
- Enables Fertigation: Water-soluble fertilizers can be injected directly to plant root zones, saving 25-30% fertilizer cost.
- Higher yield (20-30% increase) in horticultural crops, vegetables, banana, sugarcane, citrus, and cotton.

chunks.title: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana PMKSY
chunks.source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Govt of India
chunks.text:
3. SUBSIDY PATTERN
- Small & Marginal Farmers (Up to 2 hectares land): Up to 80% to 90% subsidy on micro-irrigation equipment installation cost.
- Other Farmers: Up to 45% to 55% subsidy.
Application Procedure: Farmers can apply online on their respective State Horticulture Department / Agriculture Department portals or visit the District Agriculture Officer.
